title: Angular Momentum and Torque on a Particle
body: A particle of mass $$5.0\, \text{kg}$$ has position vector $$\vec{r}=(2.0\, \text{m})\hat{i}-(3.0\, \text{m})\hat{j}$$ at a particular instant of time when its velocity is $$\vec{v}=(3.0\, \tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}})\hat{i}$$ with respect to the origin.
